architecture.mechanism: Dual Control for Exploration-Exploitation (DCEE) with a Regularized Particle Filter plus Markov Chain Monte Carlo step that jointly estimates vehicle states and road-surface (environment) parameters, folding estimation directly into the ABS controller instead of keeping it separate.
architecture.intervention: Reflash/reprogram the 2019 Silverado 1500's ABS/ESC ECU to run the DCEE estimator, fusing wheel-speed, yaw-rate, steering, and engine/PCM data (the check-engine channel) so that vehicle state and peak friction coefficient are estimated online and consumed by the brake-control loop, eliminating the detached estimation path that sets the fault state.
architecture.expected_effect: Braking ability is restored and the ABS, ESC, and check engine warnings clear, because the controller no longer operates on neglected/mismatched state and environment estimates that trigger degraded-mode operation and sub-optimal braking.
architecture.falsification_test: Reproduce the fault in the vehicle, then flash the DCEE estimator and drive the same low-speed driveway maneuver plus a documented stopping-distance run; the mechanism is falsified if any of the three warnings re-illuminates or if stopping distance/time fails to return to the pre-fault baseline.
